slides.h:
5 PowerPoint keys
for when you're
the one presenting.

slides.b: In Slide Show, press B. The room looks at you, not the slide. Press B again to come back.
Type 7 and press Enter to jump straight to slide 7. No clicking through to find it.
Your mouse becomes a red laser pointer. Ctrl + P turns it into a pen.
Slide Show, Use Presenter View. You see your notes and the next slide; they see the slide.
Slide Show, Rehearse Timings. Shows how long each slide takes before the real thing.

Tell Toso what the talk is for. Get the finished PowerPoint to present.
Pay with M-Pesa. First deck free.
